description: Optimize the geometry of an ammonia molecule.
user_prompt: Optimize the geometry of an ammonia molecule, then report the final energy and N-H bond length.

references: Fortes, Brodholt, Wood & Vočadlo, J. Chem. Phys. 118, 5987-5994 (2003)
method.modeling: Gas-phase NH3 molecule in a cubic box with at least 12 Angstrom vacuum separation.
method.rationale: The target N-H bond length of 1.022 Angstrom is reported for an optimized isolated NH3 molecule by Fortes et al. (2003). The reference calculation uses VASP with the PW91 functional and Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials, whereas this benchmark uses PBE(PAW). Only the N-H bond length is scored because the absolute molecular total energy is sensitive to PAW dataset and cell conventions. The +/-0.02 Angstrom tolerance is a benchmark acceptance threshold.
